news.title: Asian Stocks Rebound as Taiwan Leads Tech Recovery – Asia Market Wrap
news.description: Asian equities rebounded from their biggest selloff in more than 18 months, led by Taiwan after local authorities introduced measures to restore investor confidence. Treasuries fell as demand for haven assets eased. The recovery followed Friday’s rebound on Wall Street, where dip buyers emerged after a volatile week of losses driven partly by concerns that a Democratic-controlled Congress could impose tighter regulation on the AI industry.
